text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Air Groove and I went to the shopping
district to buy supplies for the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm, that's...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Come on, miss over there!
Why not give it a try?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it,
we got a lottery ticket from our shopping earlier."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm not particularly interested in the prizes, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Participating in seasonal events
is a meaningful endeavor."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's give it a try here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It troubles me to have you expect so much over something like this.
...Oh well, just watch."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove boldly
turned the lottery wheel's crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait... Grand Prize!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho... I thought you'd take it seriously if you did it,
but I didn't expect you to actually enter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And a hot springs trip voucher, no less...
I've ended up drawing something surprisingly grand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Hm? —No, wait.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I was the one who drew the lottery ticket, but
considering the two of us came to buy supplies for the Trainer's Room...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (—Who will claim this hot spring trip voucher?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Who should use it, and what would be the proper way...?)
choice_data_list: Why the long face? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It is nothing.
I was merely thinking about the owner of this ticket.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep hold of it for now.
I shall decide what to do with it later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove practically forced me
to take the hot spring trip tickets.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho, quite the fine quality of meat.
It truly earns its 'Special Grade' title.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All that's left is the seasoning, then... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do another round of the shops around here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "It is only natural. A masterpiece requires seasoning worthy of its stature, does it not?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For this dish... yes,
demi-glace sauce would go nicely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I shall gather the finest ingredients
and whip up a first-class sauce for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took another lap around the shopping district
to find a sauce worthy of the hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ho, this is quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There were a few students who mentioned wanting to practice cooking, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If we give them to those girls, they'll put them to meaningful use.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We're taking it back. Help me carry it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside a satisfied Air Groove,
I carried the carrots back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even with just a single carrot,
there are all kinds of creative ways to prepare it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's great in a salad, great for kinpira,
and it can even be made into juice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How do you prefer your food cooked?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We walked home together, chatting about the carrot dishes Air Groove recommended.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A miss, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine.
This is usually what happens when you rely purely on luck."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, in a serious bout, luck alone is not enough;
true ability is indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, having that driven home by a packet of tissues
leaves me with rather mixed feelings, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove stared at the packet of tissues
with a slight look of disappointment.
